qualification.selected_output: Save new output selections as name plus host-API identities. Resolve legacy PyAudio indices through their owning binding, and resolve sounddevice devices fresh at Kokoro utterance, simple music stream, and shared RawOutputStream start. Default/missing/ambiguous choices follow existing default fallback. Explicit open/start/mid-play failures do not authorize replay on another speaker. Shared pipeline open/start failures publish error/output_start_failed and clean up initialized components. Serialize Kokoro convenience play/wait without holding the lifecycle lock for the utterance.
qualification.checks: The combined ordered 131 shipped tests pass on Linux and with the actual CPython TCP socketpair fallback. 206 distinct focused Python methods pass in the integration runs, including independent settings/output/guard controls; additionally 57 frontend tests, 18 schema tests and two API-reset probes pass. Scoped runtime/new-test Ruff and Black, ESLint, atomic-JSON and sync-bridge checks pass under recorded commands. Broad default Ruff over all changed Python files still reports four unchanged pre-existing E701 statements in the existing execution-safety module. Original65 speech assertions remain preserved plus four new guard methods. Independent component mutation negatives are retained.
qualification.windows_guard: Only the stdlib socketpair code object, its exact client/listener, loopback address, stream family/type and listener bound endpoint can use saved connect. Unrelated application loopback, external targets, create_connection and connect_ex remain denied. This is faithful CPython fallback execution on Linux, not a genuine Windows runner result.
qualification.tool_schema_retention: Prior description compaction remains byte-identical. 76 tools serialize to 61977 UTF-8 tools-array bytes under the unchanged strict <62000 cap; 23 bytes of margin. This is neither an HTTP-envelope limit nor a model-token budget.
qualification.persistence_limit: No cross-store transaction or rollback guarantee. Credentials can persist independently when a mixed request returns False; ordinary mixed user/global updates can commit the user store before a global failure. Direct externally mutable manager.settings writes remain outside managed copy-on-write paths. Explicit staging with save_immediately=False retains its existing semantics. Existing loader selection is unchanged.
qualification.output_scope_limit: Qt, VLC, embedded/browser and native pyttsx3 playback remain separate unresolved paths. Standalone spoke constructor-selected output remains unchanged. Historical numeric identities cannot be recovered after historical PyAudio renumbering. Open streams do not immediately reroute. Shared midstream write errors retain catch-and-log behavior, and device-change timeout may still refresh despite undrained transient playback. Hot-unplug, re-enumeration, packaged playback, physical audibility and complete issue4544 closure remain unqualified.
qualification.public_aggregate_limit: The unfiltered final local public aggregate ran327 tests with one setup error because pyloudnorm is absent in PhoneLanguageSwitch. No other failures were found; this remains an incomplete aggregate, not full acceptance.
qualification.native_windows_evidence: The prior public27 Windows Python3.11.9 run reported 296 tests,21 failures,2 errors. It remains rejected evidence; this synthetic repair does not replace a new genuine exact-head Windows run.
qualification.integration_limit: Adopt the resulting public pin with the canonical ownership composition. Add the four new paths in the source-plan inventory alongside the already required speech regression mapping. Do not copy public runtime code into private shadows.
